title: Production application bootstrap for an admitted normal-run profile
objective: Create one authoritative Fortran/FMR-owned typed production bootstrap that can run an admitted standalone Reference Richards profile and materialize F-GC49D contexts from the same persistent owner, without qualification fixtures, new physics or legacy parsing.
exact_scope: typed config to persistent Fortran/FMR owner
persistent committed state, participant registry and mass-ledger ownership
per-window F-GC49D context materialization from admitted topology/predictor/cell-area inputs
exclusions: Python ownership of SWAP/FMR state or ledgers

markers: PPA-WU01 PRODUCTION APPLICATION BOOTSTRAP OWNER GATE PASS

next_permitted_action: Require the automatically triggered final checks for this reconciled head. Then perform one live overlap check. Merge PR #306 if WU01 owner, documentation and F-CI canonical qualification pass and any later canonical drift is absent or publication-only/disjoint.

repairs.finding: An experimental mode-5 standalone trajectory was transactionally rejected despite profile admission.
repairs.disposition: The qualification was bound back to existing authority: standalone uses the already-qualified serialized Reference bottom_mode=7 profile; mode 5 remains the groundwater participant profile. No solver or physics change.

repairs.finding: The first owner implementation unconditionally created the groundwater participant registry, causing standalone mode 7 initialization to fail because the groundwater materializer correctly admits only the mode-5 participant profile.
repairs.disposition: Groundwater registry, materializers, ledgers and handles became optional profile-bound ownership. The generic FMR owner is independent; all-mode-5 configs get groundwater ownership; mixed 5/7 configs fail closed.

admitted_restricted_profiles.groundwater: Serialized Reference Richards participant bootstrap, bottom_mode=5, typed datum, participant registry, mass ledger and F-GC49D context materialization.
